features.teamsDetails: Team grouping, lead assignments, and department member organization are pending backend API implementation.
features.sprintsDetails: Sprint cycles, duration tracking, and backlog sprint assignments are pending backend API endpoint implementation.
features.notificationsDetails: Real-time and persistent notification delivery (task assignments, mentions, status changes) are pending backend controller implementation.
features.companyNoticeDetails: The Company business logic (getAllCompany, getOne, create, leftCompany, addOrRemoveMemberCompany) exists in the backend module (api/Modules/Company/Company.js), but Express route mounting in api/app.js is currently pending.
